critique: All five are Manhattan grants with a stated award, a deadline and stated eligibility. Narrow eligibility (performing arts only, Upper Manhattan only) is noted in the reasons. The listings left out either have no award or no stated eligibility (r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12) or require college enrollment or an O-1 visa (r1), so none is clearly better than r4 or r5.
